summary: Evangeline Parish lookout listed under the Louisiana Forestry Commission; Wikipedia says torn down, the Forest Lookouts site says removed. No build, staffing or fire record found.

facts.status_note: Wikipedia list says torn down; the Forest Lookouts site says removed; no removal date given

evidence.supports: agency is the Louisiana Forestry Commission
in 1915 funds for fire protection work allowed hiring lookout watchmen
evidence.quote: In 1915 funds were directed for fire protection work allowing the hiring of lookout watchmen or patrolmen.

evidence.supports: first steel fire tower built near Bogalusa in 1922
evidence.quote: In 1922 the first steel fire tower was built near Bogalusa on Great Southern Lumber Company land.

evidence.supports: second tower built near Urania in 1923
evidence.quote: In 1923 the second tower was built near Urania

evidence.supports: before the first two towers, rungs were nailed to a pine tree with a perch near the top
evidence.quote: Prior to these two towers rungs were nailed to a pine tree with a perch erected near the top.
By 1943 thirty-nine fire towers had been built and by 1950 the number had increased to fifty-six.

Forest Lookouts site records the tower as removed

evidence.quote: Unable to view on street view or older aerial imagery.

sources.title: List of fire lookout towers in Louisiana

notes_for_editor: Only two pages were usable: the Wikipedia Louisiana table (status, street-view note) and the Forest Lookouts page (agency, township-range-section code 3S-2W-Sec.22, status). Two searches gave no build date, staffing, fire or current-site record, so the story says nothing on those. The firetower.org Louisiana index does not list this tower, and the firelookout.org Louisiana page is a placeholder. A Facebook group post mentioning a Beaver fire tower in Ville Platte appeared in search results, but the page is login-walled and was not used. Brief coordinates (30.7802, -92.55847) differ from Wikipedia (30.78028, -92.55833) by roughly 15 m, probably rounding; not corrected. Access is not recorded because no source says whether the site is public.
